We need to determine the appropriate charge(s) for the described case.

Facts: In July 2014, Li (李某乙) helped Lu (陆某) register an account on a website, then Lu pretended to be a woman named Yan Yan, used dating/ matchmaking to meet defendant Tang (唐某). Lu claimed his brother is in building materials business, knows a seller of Taiwanese fake RMB, and gets Tang to buy fake currency. On July 14, Lu, Li, and Li (another) meet Tang at a hotel; Li pretends to be Lu's brother, Li (the other) pretends to be the seller of Taiwanese fake currency. They show real RMB and fake Taiwanese RMB to gain trust, then sell fake currency. On July 16, Tang buys 62,000 (actually 62,000? Wait: 62万 = 620,000) of fake currency for 12万 RMB. He later discovers they are all funeral money (冥币) disguised as Taiwanese fake currency. On Sep 5, police investigate, Tang voluntarily surrenders and confesses.

So the crime: The defendants (Lu, Li, Li) sold fake currency. The charge list includes "出售、购买、运输假币" (sell, purchase, transport counterfeit currency). Also "持有、使用假币" (possession/use). The defendant Tang is the buyer, but he voluntarily surrendered. The question: "请你模拟法官依据下面事实给出罪名。" The facts focus on Tang's involvement? Actually the description includes the whole scheme, but the defendant is Tang (被告人唐某). He purchased fake currency. He voluntarily surrendered. The charge for him would be "购买假币" (buying counterfeit currency). The list includes "出售、购买、运输假币". So that covers purchase. Also maybe "持有、使用假币" if he possessed. But the main is purchase. The list includes "出售、购买、运输假币". So we can assign that.

Is there any other charge? Possibly "诈骗"? No, they sold fake currency, which is a counterfeit currency crime, not fraud per se. The list includes "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章" etc. Not relevant. So answer: [罪名]出售、购买、运输假币<eoa>
